title: DLLM-TTS：用于文本到语音合成的块离散扩散语言模型
summary: DLLM-TTS将TTS建模为基于X-Codec2音频编解码器令牌的条件块离散扩散，在块内并行预测令牌，同时顺序处理块，兼顾局部声学连贯性和全局文本-语音对齐。0.6B参数模型在20K小时数据上训练，RTF为0.15，在Seed-TTS-eval基准上表现优异，实现高效且数据高效的并行语音合成。
summary_en: DLLM-TTS formulates TTS as conditional block discrete diffusion over X-Codec2 tokens, enabling parallel token prediction within blocks while processing blocks sequentially. A 0.6B model trained on 20K hours achieves competitive performance with RTF 0.15, offering efficient and data-efficient speech synthesis.
